findings.issue: Deterministic claim-lineage records and recipe execution call Moments.summary() without deterministic=True. The planned deterministic scenario repeats its fixed cases five times, so these paths generate Student-t confidence intervals from dependent repetitions. compare_scenario correctly suppresses those intervals, creating inconsistent statistical handling within the supplement.
findings.why_it_matters: The executable lineage artifacts can attach unsupported confidence intervals and precision assessments to deterministic numeric claims, contrary to the approved protocol.
findings.suggested_fix_or_test: Within analysis/, carry a validated deterministic designation from the source manifests into lineage recipes and records, suppress inferential intervals for deterministic rows, and reject incompatible mixed-source recipes. Add a regression checking that both a deterministic lineage record and its executed recipe have null CI and halfwidth fields while preserving the descriptive mean and denominator.

findings.location: analysis/supplement/checker.py: run_native exception handling; sim/src/verifier.py: checks_boolean and outcomes; @repo/lab/verification.py: custom_verify
findings.issue: A rejected native invocation is diagnosed only from checks.yaml. Fresh verification.yaml prediction failures are ignored. P4 activation and P6 ledger failures can occur without a corresponding failed checks_boolean entry. If statistical-precision is the sole failed check while a prediction item also fails, run_native labels the attempt solely as statistical INCONCLUSIVE; with no failed checks it leaves such a prediction rejection INCOMPLETE.
findings.why_it_matters: The receipt can misdescribe a native prediction contradiction as a precision or execution limitation. The supplement provides additional protection, but the selected native attempt still needs an accurate failure account.
findings.suggested_fix_or_test: Within analysis/, inspect and validate fresh stage VerificationItems when available, record their failed prediction references separately, and preserve numerical failures alongside precision failures. Do not read a pre-existing stage as evidence of the new attempt. Add isolated cases for P4/P6 FAIL items with passing checks and with statistical-precision also failing.

summary: Revise the analysis supplement before treating its lineage and native-attempt receipts as review-ready.
Deterministic lineage currently creates unsupported Student-t intervals from repeated fixed cases.
Native rejection receipts can omit failed prediction items and misclassify the failure reason.
The reviewed normalized physics and exact model derivations are internally consistent.
The supplement substantially improves original-constraint, mask, ledger and endpoint checks over the native verifier alone.
Shared oracle replay is correctly distinguished from an additional independent optimizer.
Common draws, matched OMA and conditional denominators are explicitly checked in source.
Exact-binomial bounds and undefined-denominator handling are present.
Hashes, full coverage, numerical interoperability and execution costs remain unverified.
The illustrated fractional boundary remains unresolved and cannot support an unqualified scientific PASS.
After the analysis fixes, finite canonical checks may precede an honestly scoped P6 report that preserves all remaining uncertainty.
No gate decision or locked-science change is made by this review.
